roleProfile.title: Product Operations Manager
roleProfile.summary: Mid-level product operations role focused on reporting ownership, dashboarding, process improvement, and cross-functional coordination in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment. The role sits between product, operations, and commercial stakeholders and requires structured analysis, communication strength, and the ability to create clarity across multiple teams.

mustHave: experience in operations, business analysis, product operations, or similar roles
ability to work in fast-paced environments
preferred: experience in SaaS or B2B software environments
experience working closely with Product teams
experience owning processes or initiatives end-to-end
familiarity with customer lifecycle or success operations

responsibilities: own recurring operational and product performance reporting
build and improve dashboards for internal stakeholders
partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success
translate business needs into reporting and workflow improvements
present insights and updates to senior stakeholders
successSignals: turns friction points into actionable improvements
ambiguities: scope of formal ownership is not fully specified
people management is not clearly required
level of senior stakeholder exposure expected is implied but not sharply defined
